ExampleDesign.Name: cpm6_pcie_rp
ExampleDesign.DisplayName: Versal CPM6 PCIe Root Port Design
ExampleDesign.Description: Versal CPM6 PCIe Root Port design in AXI_Bridge mode, with and without LPDDR5 via NoC, and in PL_Streaming mode. Controller_0 or Controller_1. Both modes support link widths x2, x4 and x8 at lane rates 16.0, 32.0 and 64.0 GT/s, defaulting to x8 at 64.0 GT/s. PL_Streaming has no NoC/DDR path, so LPDDR5 is available in AXI_Bridge mode only.
